Message:
God only subjects us to trials
that we can overcome.

On that day,
when Florence and I
overcame the trial set before us,
the bond between us
grew stronger than ever.

But, there are times when
it looks like something is
weighing on Florence’s mind...

Seeing her like that
makes my heart uneasy.

And since she never deliberately
acts that way in front of me,
it worries me all the more...

“I heard, that if two people
make a vow to each other
beneath the setting sun,
they will be blessed
by Heaven above.”

When I mentioned
that superstition surrounding
the sunset to Florence,
she gazed at me.

Her eyes were more focused
than I’d ever seen them before.

The two of us endured
every trial thrown at us,
so it’s high time we did it—
make a new vow.”

There was a
quiet resolve in her eyes.
This was surely
no simple promise to Florence.

No, it must be something
even more important.
If it means that much to her...

“I would love that.
I shall hold you
to it then, Florence.”

If that would clear away
whatever trouble is
weighing on your heart...

Then, just like we did back
when we were younger,
we made a promise to each other.

“Let us vow anew,
beneath the setting sun.”
